beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Student forms now explain that first and last names should match Pathways, while preferred names can be anything.
• Sample comparison controls are clearer, with the option to delete either sample.

Fixes:
• Preferred names now appear in the verification window, reopened sample headers, progress grid, and exception paperwork. Queued samples use the current preferred name when opened.
• Searching the progress grid now finds students by their preferred names.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Review and grading share a compact document toolbar with Undo, page editing, and zoom controls. Sample comparison is clearer, with choices to replace, keep, or delete samples.
• New samples use a four-square header, with six-square available in Settings. Task text can be previewed before adding it to a sample.
• Preferred student names carry through verification, headers, progress-grid searches, and paperwork. Roster sync lets you review incoming changes.
• Google Drive setup is simpler, and folder recovery provides clearer choices when your work folder is temporarily unavailable.
• Learning-period to-dos are grouped by workflow stage. Windows updates show installation progress and reopen Buddy automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed Schoology files failing to open, re-download errors, stale Missing indicators, and repeated sync attempts. Review now preserves the selected course and learning period.
• Fixed incoming and manually assigned samples losing source files or being overlooked as duplicates. Corrected work sent with the same filename now reaches review.
• Failed AI analysis offers recovery or manual review, preserves existing grades and feedback, and no longer supplies fallback full credit.
• Fixed crashes displaying incoming-sample review badges, empty previews, page-selection issues during rotation, and roster-sync database errors.
• Improved Windows startup and browser connection packaging, and removed personal information from uploaded crash reports.
